un-yearbook.label: UN Demographic Yearbook
un-yearbook.scope: Figures submitted by national statistical offices. The latest available edition supplies each observation. Country footnotes can qualify what was counted. Observations explicitly identified as different measures, such as applications or counts including miscarriages, are omitted.

eurostat.label: Eurostat
eurostat.scope: Reported legally induced abortions, all ages. Country reporting and status flags vary. The original snapshot includes overlapping geographic variants.

new-zealand.label: New Zealand national statistics
new-zealand.scope: Registered induced abortions from Stats NZ and subsequent Ministry of Health reporting. The Ministry's revised figures take precedence for overlapping years.

south-africa.label: South Africa public-sector DHIS
south-africa.scope: Reported terminations in the public health system. The year shown is the end of the April–March financial year. Private-sector procedures are outside this series.

guttmacher.label: Guttmacher incidence data
guttmacher.scope: Single-year official statistics marked complete and excluding spontaneous abortions. Years with conflicting eligible counts are omitted.

cdc.label: CDC surveillance
cdc.scope: Reported abortions in participating U.S. jurisdictions. Reporting coverage varies by year.
